items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: Bill Matthews playing trombone. Guy Kelly playing trumpet. And Saif Frazier played the drums. Simon Marrera played the bass violin. I played the banjo.

ctx.x: A lot of people, you know, somebody tells them something and they don't have it on tape, they just make a note and they spell it wrong and can't read their own writing. I'm that way myself. This is said Bill Matthews on trombone. That's in the Biloxi job. Is that right? Yeah.

But this wasn't the first band that we had when we played on that job. We had Oscar Ruzon, I mean Joe Ruzon playing tenor saxophone. And Clarence Hall playing alto saxophone. Bill Matthews playing trombone. Guy Kelly playing trumpet. And Saif Frazier played the drums. Simon Marrera played the bass violin. I played the banjo. And Ricard Alexis played trumpet. Yeah. But this person was Cecil. Not Caesar.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: And every Sunday, Kimmel had a Buick Roast call, and I had a force on the Dodge call, well I used to drive home every Sunday

ctx.x: You see, that's Marvin Kimmel's wife. Right. Jeanette's, well we called her Sullivan, but I don't think she, yeah she married to Kimmel then, that's right. So I used to bring money for him, for Kimmel to help people, that girl came from, from, uh, uh, Patschristian, Mississippi. Mm-hmm. And every Sunday, Kimmel had a Buick Roast call, and I had a force on the Dodge call, well I used to drive home every Sunday, and go back on a Monday morning, well I used to ride Caesar, that's all the sax section, and sometimes…
